# Awesome Journal Skills (AJS)

license: `MIT` · 25 skills · last update: 2026-07-23

**Source:** <https://github.com/brycewang-stanford/Awesome-Journal-Skills>

**Maintainers:** Bryce Wang (Stanford REAP / CoPaper.AI)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code` `codex`

> Despite the "Awesome" name this is not a link list: the repo ships 4,150 first-party SKILL.md skills across 299 installable Claude-plugin packs — per-journal depth packs (~12 lifecycle skills each: topic selection, identification, robustness, tables/figures, writing style, referee strategy, rebuttal, replication package, submission) for top venues in economics, finance, management, accounting, and beyond, plus discipline-wide breadth bundles (one venue-fit skill per journal, 100+ journals each) and a cross-journal Research-Toolkit. Content is genuinely journal-specific (editors, acceptance norms, house style, canon), not find-replace boilerplate. This manifest catalogs 25 representative skills: the full 7-skill cross-journal Research-Toolkit, the full 12-skill QJE depth pack as the exemplar, the workflow routers of five further depth packs (Econometrica, JPE, REStud, Management Science, MIS Quarterly), and one breadth-bundle venue-fit skill (AER). The AER depth pack lives in the separate brycewang-stanford/AER-skills repo, cataloged in RISE under the auto-empirical-research-skills pack.


**Source YAML:** [`skills/awesome-journal-skills.yml`](https://github.com/bhanneke/RISE/blob/main/skills/awesome-journal-skills.yml)
